rows.label: Withholding of employment and services tax
rows.value: Employers deduct employment tax from every payment and pay it with a monthly withholding return by the 15th of the following month, with an annual return within 15 days of the end of the financial year; the tax is final (employees file no return); fringe benefits such as free housing or a vehicle are not taxed
rows.note: The source gives no separate start date for this figure; stored from the start of the 2026-27 tax year (1 July 2026).
